title: AT&T customers can earn miles by linking accounts
text:
AT&T customers can earn miles by linking accounts The daily brief for frequent flyers
 Today Topics Archive American AAdvantage AT&T customers can earn miles by linking accounts
 American Airlines and AT&T are offering eligible customers bonus AAdvantage miles for linking their accounts. The first 65,000 eligible customers to complete the link receive 5,000 miles, while later eligible participants receive 2,500. Customers must locate the promotion through AT&T's benefits portal.
 Originally reported by milestomemories.com · 5,000 Free AAdvantage Miles for AT&T Customers! Act Quick 
 Edited by Randy Petersen 
 Oct 26 · 8:07 PM · 1 min
 Key details Program AAdvantage Partners American Airlines and AT&T Top bonus 5,000 miles Later bonus 2,500 miles First tier First 65,000 eligible customers Customers reach the promotion by signing in to AT&T & More Benefits and opening the Explore section. The offer requires connecting an AT&T account with an AAdvantage account; the article says its own process took about 30 seconds. No calendar end date is stated, leaving the number of qualifying account links as the only specified threshold.
 The offer is structured in two tiers: once the first 65,000 eligible account links have been reached, the stated bonus falls from 5,000 miles to 2,500 miles. The article provides no other eligibility rules, redemption details or expiration date. Customers therefore cannot determine from the published terms how long the larger award will remain available.
 Why it matters The mile award is worth 2,500 fewer once the initial allocation is exhausted, making timing the only stated factor that changes the bonus. With no expiration date or further terms provided, customers have limited information for judging urgency.
